items.title: Burke Stevenson Interview, 1959-06-12
items.q: No, Buddy, I never got a chance to play with Buddy in the band.

ctx.x: Oh, you got to hear him a good deal too?
Yeah, Buddy was one of the best second trumpet players I think was around here. He could play plenty second. Yeah, he was good on that Buddy Petit.
Did you ever play with him in the band?
